data.name: Macromancer
data.detailed_description:
Macromancer is a programming RPG sandbox where anything can be automated with the power of Pythonic* coding. You can write scripts to farm for loot, grind levels, or string together gear-crafting pipelines. Everything that your character can do is accessible through coding APIs. If you're looking for a fun way to learn to code, or want to live out the fantasy of botting in an MMO, then you've found the right game.

The world of Macromancer has dungeons, mines, and farmlands to explore and automate. As you explore and level up, you'll empower an ever-growing party of characters with new abilities and gear. To take on the toughest challenges, you'll need to group up and form 5-character dungeoneering squads. If you don't have 4 friends to join you in multiplayer, you'll need to make some new ones with Python-ey* scripting. 

*Macromancer is built around MacroPy, which feels like python, but isn't for many important security reasons. Real python coding is technically supported, but its only available for those experienced enough to work through out the setup process.
